size.title: size
size.description: Image resolution: 1K (1024px), 2K (2048px), 4K (4096px), or 'custom' for specific dimensions.

width.title: Width
width.description: Custom image width (only used when size='custom'). Range: 1024-4096 pixels.

height.title: Height
height.description: Custom image height (only used when size='custom'). Range: 1024-4096 pixels.

max_images.title: Max Images
max_images.description: Maximum number of images to generate when sequential_image_generation='auto'. Range: 1-15. Total images (input + generated) cannot exceed 15.

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input image(s) for image-to-image generation. List of 1-10 images for single or multi-reference generation.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Image aspect ratio. Only used when size is not 'custom'. Use 'match_input_image' to automatically match the input image's aspect ratio.

enhance_prompt.title: Enhance Prompt
enhance_prompt.description: Enable prompt enhancement for higher quality results, this will take longer to generate.

sequential_image_generation.title: sequential_image_generation
sequential_image_generation.description: Group image generation mode. 'disabled' generates a single image. 'auto' lets the model decide whether to generate multiple related images (e.g., story scenes, character variations).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A text description of the image you want to generate

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input images to transform or use as reference (supports multiple images)

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation

image.title: Image
image.description: Input image for image to image mode. The aspect ratio of your output will match this image

go_fast.title: Go Fast
go_fast.description: Run faster predictions with additional optimizations.

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.description: Guidance for generated image. Lower values can give more realistic images. Good values to try are 2, 2.5, 3 and 3.5

megapixels.title: megapixels
megapixels.description: Approximate number of megapixels for generated image

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image

output_quality.title: Output Quality
output_quality.description: Quality when saving the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality. Not relevant for .png outputs

prompt_strength.title: Prompt Strength
prompt_strength.description: Prompt strength when using img2img. 1.0 corresponds to full destruction of information in image

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps. Recommended range is 28-50, and lower number of steps produce lower quality outputs, faster.
